description: Diagrams (section 4.17): the graph that a rule sees, as Mermaid or DOT text. The constraint of the rule is not evaluated; only the slices of `must_be_acyclic` and `must_be_independent`, or the `layers` of the case, change the nodes.

cases.name: the subjects are the nodes, and the nodes and edges of a cycle are red

expect.diagram:
---
title: "the modules"
---
flowchart LR
    n0["crate::api"]
    n1["crate::api::v1"]
    n2["crate::db"]
    n3["crate::util"]
    n4["crate::say #quot;hi#quot; #35;1"]
    n0 --> n2
    n0 --> n3
    n1 --> n0
    n2 --> n0
    n2 --> n3
    n4 --> n3
    classDef cycle stroke:#d62728,stroke-width:2px
    class n0,n2 cycle
    linkStyle 0,3 stroke:#d62728,stroke-width:2px
